needs.proposedSignature: `Filter.enteredThisTurn?: boolean` (matched from the engine's existing per-object entered-turn stamp) and a `Ref`/filter for "a card put into a graveyard this way" — e.g. `{ op: 'destroy'; …; remember?: true }` recording the cards it moved, readable as `{ ref: 'those' }` by a following `return-from-graveyard`
needs.semantics: Two adjacent gaps on gift cards whose bodies would otherwise be writable: "target creature token that entered the battlefield this turn" needs an entered-this-turn predicate on `Filter` (which has `token` but nothing about when it arrived), and "return a creature card put into your graveyard this way" needs the destroy to remember which cards it moved so a later effect in the same resolution can name them.

needs.proposedSignature: a face declaration `gift?: { what: string; effects: Effect[] }` (the promise and what the promised opponent gets) + a `covers[].by` kind 'gift' anchored on /^gift (a|an) (.+)$/ + a Condition variant `{ kind: 'gift-promised'; not?: boolean }`; the promise is an optional cast-time choice recorded on the StackItem (alongside `kicked` / `castWith`) and the gift's effects resolve for the promised opponent before the spell's own effects
needs.semantics: As you cast the spell you may promise an opponent a gift (CR 702.176a). If you did, that opponent gets the named gift before the spell's other effects resolve, and later clauses on the same spell branch on whether the gift was promised ("If the gift was promised, ..." / "If the gift wasn't promised, ..."). Neither the promise nor the condition that reads it exists today, so both the printed keyword line and the conditional half of every gift card's body are unwritable. This is the same family already recorded for Bilbo's Gambit (data/scripts/blocked/ef/ef71ef07-8a35-41ec-a851-d95e9e3a221b.json); 11 more cards in this batch alone wait on it.
needs.clause: Gift a card / Gift a tapped Fish / Gift an Octopus / Gift an extra turn, and every "If the gift was promised, ..." clause
